title: Naylor Fitzhugh Professor of Business Administration Senior Associate Dean and Chair of the MBA Program
bio: What Leadership Looks Like in an Agentic AI World Generative AI can do far more than synthesize emails and write reports. Tsedal Neeley explains how leaders can harness agentic AI to create their own digital support team to power their performance.
